layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Pachycephalosaurus head morphology
features: A large, smooth, rounded bone-colored clay dome on top of the head
The dome is surrounded by small, blunt clay spikes and nodes around the base and back of the skull
Soft teal or sandy-brown clay skin with subtle, hand-pressed scale textures
A friendly, toy-like face with large expressive eyes and a small, toothless beak
Cinematic macro shot focusing on the thickness and texture of the 'bone' dome
layer_3_action.action: A profile macro shot of a Pachycephalosaurus head. The focus is on the massive, smooth clay dome that crowns its skull, emphasizing its density and rounded shape. The background features a soft, blurred lush forest in warm studio lighting. No text.
